events.title: Play our demo at Steam Next Fest! Streams and videos welcome
events.summary: Looking for something to play during Steam Next Fest? Try the free demo of Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year! Enjoy the unconventional investigations and lively banter of a zombie detective and her human junior partner. We welcome livestreams and gameplay videos of the demo! Individuals and companies are welcome, no advance contact is needed, and monetization is allowed. events.title: The demo has been updated!
events.summary: We've updated the demo for Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year. If you've already downloaded it, please update to the latest version before playing. New players can download the demo for free from our Steam store page. Thank you to everyone who's tried it! We'd love to hear what you think.

events.title: Free demo out now! Play all of Chapter 0
events.summary: Hello everyone! We're Lobstudio. The free demo for Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year is now available on Steam! The demo lets you play all of Chapter 0, the opening of the story. It takes around 10–20 minutes to complete. Meet Detective Zomby Akemi Kabane and her junior partner, Yasu Tamura, a fan of police dramas. Enjoy this mismatched duo's banter and the opening of a new case ahead of the full release! events.title: Zombie Police joins Steam Next Fest! Play Chapter 0 in the demo
events.summary: Thank you for following Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year! This is Lobstudio. We're excited to announce that the game is joining Steam Next Fest in October 2026! You can play the demo during the festival. Festival Dates October 19–26, 2026 (starts at 10:00 AM PT) What's in the Demo Play Chapter 0 (about 10–20 minutes).
